implementation.scope: Existing scalar self-recursion eligibility in closed AOT and optimized reloadable JIT
implementation.publication: Each complete layer is evaluated in a temporary clone and committed only within the instruction cap

measurement.aggregation: Median and sample CV of every iteration sample; no outlier filtering
limitations: Tooling regression continued on other logical CPUs; C++ controls and variation are retained
Primary AOT Fibonacci CV is below 2%; its C++ control drift is below 5%
JIT and managed-reference queens remain controls; no meaningful speedup is claimed for them
The instruction cap bounds this transformation before LLVM O3, not final machine-code bytes
The high-variance exploratory baseline and short loaded JIT probe are not performance evidence
